description: This file defines the FontMapper class responsible for mapping font styles and properties between the MigraDoc DocumentObjectModel and the PdfSharp Charting Font objects. It includes methods for mapping individual font objects, styles from the document style collection, and techniques for handling font attributes such as color, size, and text decorations.

classes.name: FontMapper
classes.description: A class providing static and instance methods to map font styles and properties from MigraDoc's DocumentObjectModel to PdfSharp's Font objects.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a MigraDoc DocumentObjectModel.Font object to a PdfSharp.Drawing.Font object, including attributes like bold, color, italic, name, size, subscript, superscript, and underline.

methods.name: Map (static, style-based)
methods.description: Maps style-defined font properties from a specified style in a MigraDoc document to a PdfSharp font object using the MapObject method.

methods.name: Map (static, font-based)
methods.description: Maps properties directly from a MigraDoc Font object to a PdfSharp font object using the MapObject method.

search-terms: Mapping Font from MigraDoc to PdfSharp
